name: @dev-kit/harness
description: Adaptive Engineer Harness — install and upgrade GitHub Copilot skills, agents, and team knowledge globally
//bundledDependencies: yaml ships INSIDE the tarball so a hand-delivered package installs without reaching a registry — it is the harness's only hard runtime dependency (zero transitive deps of its own) and the tree-sitter grammars stay optional, degrading to the lexical tier when unavailable. The trade is that the pinned version is what every consumer gets, registry installs included: they can no longer resolve a patched yaml themselves, so a yaml CVE is OUR republish. Keep the floor at a version with no known advisory (^2.9.0 clears CVE-2026-33532, which ^2.8.0 permitted) and re-check on every release.
